hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *k8s-manifest/*.yaml|*k8s-manifest/*.yml|*/docs/*.md) if git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all -- "$f" 2>/dev/null | grep -qE '^(\?\?|A )'; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"A new file was just added to this repo (%s). Per project convention, update README.md and docs/MODEL-INDEX.md to reference it (add the model/manifest entry to MODEL-INDEX; keep the README structure section current)."}}' "$f"; fi;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
